params.prompt: Photo-real establishing shot for a Korean sitcom, 9:16 vertical, evening. Reference image 1 is the exact living room (caramel corduroy sofa, round oak coffee table with tomato-red tray, mustard armchair, marble kitchen island with black stools, oak stairs, herringbone floor, string lights, arched window): keep every piece of furniture, art and color, but make it evening: window dark navy, warm lamps and string lights on, no daylight. Wide shot from the entrance side at eye level, the sofa in the foreground-left and the kitchen island in the midground-right, both fully visible. Reference image 2 gives the two people: keep their exact faces, hair, glasses and clothes. The man (navy overshirt, round gold glasses, ID badge) sits on the sofa holding a phone in both hands looking down. The woman (white shirt, dark jeans, long dark wavy hair) sits on a black stool at the island with a phone. Behind the island a Nepali man (31, deep brown skin, black curly hair, short beard, white chef jacket, beige towel on shoulder, navy half-apron) stands holding a glass pickle jar. People are small in the frame, the whole room reads. No text, no watermark, natural skin. KEEP this exact staging, camera distance, furniture placement and room; change only what follows. Situation: 밤 10시 1층 거실. 준호는 소파, 비아는 아일랜드, 수만은 아일랜드 뒤. 로고와 제목이 위에 뜬다. Emotion: 평온. Action: 와이드, 느린 줌. Director's note: 이미지가 뭉개져있음. The first reference images are the exact faces to keep; identity must match them exactly. Candid mid-action, like a frame grabbed from video.
